findings.concern: symbol equality could silently become a name-only FFI join
findings.resolution: a result requires target-owned CAMLprim source, identical Dune source mirror, and an nm witness in a target stub artefact; fixtures reject membership, mirror and symbol loss.

findings.concern: two definitions or targets might select one arbitrary binding
findings.resolution: witnesses are deduplicated only across archive/shared copies of the same target-definition; distinct eligible definitions remain MAY_TOP(ffi) with ambiguous_strict_witnesses.

findings.concern: an exported stub could be described as full ABI or call-graph proof
findings.resolution: the output scope/spec exclude ABI signatures, loaded images, graph edges and MUST claims.

accepted_limits: Only direct Dune foreign_stubs conventional artefacts are covered.
Source mirror equality is a current-build witness, not a final executable load proof.
